description: This file defines a utility function 'searchRdkProfile' that reads a device properties file to determine the device profile (TV or STB) based on the 'RDK_PROFILE' property. It includes necessary headers, defines macros for profile strings, and declares an enum for profile types.

methods.name: searchRdkProfile
methods.description: Reads '/etc/device.properties' to find the 'RDK_PROFILE' setting and returns the corresponding profile enum (TV or STB).
